item.title: Mobius: macOS App for Automatic Claude Code Account Switching
item.description: Mobius is a macOS menu bar app that automatically switches Claude Code or Codex CLI sessions when an account hits its usage limit and returns once limits reset.

item.title: CamLoop: On-Device AI Virtual Camera for Stepping Away Mid-Meeting
item.description: CamLoop uses ping-pong looping, on-device pose alignment, frame morphing, and exposure checks on macOS so users can step away smoothly on video calls.
